issues.display_title: Issue #1882: feat(blog): SEO Optimization, Metadata Integration, and Lighthouse Audit Fixes
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Enhance SEO performance and metadata for the Villume Blog to ensure strong discoverability on search engines (Google), achieve a perfect Lighthouse SEO audit score (100), and provide polished, engaging link previews when articles are shared across social platforms (WhatsApp, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook).

Background & Problems

  1. Lighthouse SEO Audit Opportunities:
    • Generic link labels (such as "Information" and "here") impacted search engine crawl friendliness and accessibility scores.
    • robots.txt validation experienced issues on development testing environments.
  2. Social Media Link Previews:
    • Shared article links did not automatically display the article's featured image, custom summary, or author details.
  3. Incomplete Sitemap:
    • The new blog and several public informational pages were missing from the sitemap, preventing search engines from discovering and indexing them effectively.

Scope of Improvements

  1. Clear Link Text:
    • Update link labels to be descriptive and helpful for both visitors and search crawlers.
  2. Dynamic Metadata & Social Previews:
    • Automatically populate each blog post's title, summary description, cover image, author name, and publish date for Open Graph and Twitter cards.
  3. Article Structured Data (Rich Snippets):
    • Add standard article structured data (Schema.org) so search engines can recognize and showcase Villume blog posts as rich results.
  4. Sitemap & Robots Update:
    • Register the blog and key public pages in the sitemap while retaining legacy domain entries.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Lighthouse SEO audit on the blog reaches a 100 score.
  • Social media previews (Open Graph & Twitter cards) correctly display article thumbnail, title, and excerpt.
  • Blog and article pages are properly indexed and crawl-friendly.
  • Sitemap includes the new blog and essential public routes without removing existing links.
  • Application builds and renders cleanly with server-side rendering (SSR).

issues.display_title: Issue #1884: feat(blog): add Blog to header navigation and restrict sidebar Blog menu to support accounts
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

We want to improve the visibility of the Blog for all website visitors and regular users, while ensuring administrative Blog access in the sidebar dashboard is reserved strictly for Support accounts.

Summary of Changes

  1. Header Navigation (All Users)
    • Add a direct link to Blog in the top navigation bar and mobile drawer.
    • For visitors browsing the marketing site, Blog will appear in the main navigation menu (between Exhibitions and FAQ).
    • For logged-in users, Blog will appear in the top navigation bar (between Settings and News).

User Experience Goals

  • Visitors and regular users can easily discover and read blog articles from the header on any page.
  • Regular user dashboards stay focused and uncluttered, without showing admin-level blog management tools.
  • Support staff retain full access to manage and create blog posts directly from their sidebar.
